patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I tried to fix it myself with nail clippers and, in hindsight, that was the mistake. Now it's angry and I can't get a shoe on.
presentation.triageNote: 45-year-old female with five days of a painful ingrown great toenail with local redness, no spreading cellulitis and no fever.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable localized ingrown toenail requires one simple procedure for partial nail treatment.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has localized nail-fold inflammation without spreading infection or systemic illness.
clinical.acuityReason: This stable localized ingrown toenail requires one simple procedure for partial nail treatment.
expectedResources: Partial nail avulsion or local nail procedure
teachingPoints: One procedure, one resource — a textbook the assigned acuity. Always check for diabetes or vascular disease, which would change the whole picture; she has neither.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A local anesthetic procedure and wound-care guidance would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 45-year-old woman in casual clothes with one shoe off and a bare foot, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one leg crossed over the other knee, holding the bare foot up to look at the toe. Expression: mildly annoyed and self-conscious. Clearly visible: one big toe red and swollen along the nail edge; one shoe off on the floor. Overall: entirely well, sore toe. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
